prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can help—do you mean UV tanning (beds) or spray/tanning booths? Also, which part of Tyler are you near (zip or cross streets)?

If you want a quick way to find the best salon yourself, look for these things:

- Recent high average ratings on Google Maps and Yelp (4.0+ and lots of recent reviews).
- Review details mentioning cleanliness, friendly/professional staff, well-maintained equipment and honest pricing.
- Certified staff and visible sanitation procedures (clean beds/booths, fresh linens, disinfectant).
- Variety of options if you want them (spray, high-pressure beds, stand-up booths) and clear pricing or packages.
- Transparent skin-type guidance and written/session limits; staff who ask about medications or photosensitizing conditions.
- Good location/hours and a membership or package that fits your budget.

Safety tips:
- Follow recommended exposure times for your skin type; don’t “push through” redness.
- Wait at least 48 hours between bed sessions (follow salon guidance).
- Use eye protection and avoid tanning if you take photosensitizing meds.
- Consider spray tanning if you want color without UV exposure.

If you tell me UV vs spray and where exactly in Tyler you are, I’ll suggest several top-rated salons in that area and what to watch for in their reviews.
